questions.question: A man buys an article for Rs. 1,500 and sells it at a profit of 20%. What is the selling price?
questions.explanation: Cost price = Rs. 1,500. Profit = 20%. Selling price = 1500 × 1.20 = Rs. 1,800.

questions.explanation: Let total work = 180 man-days (12×15). 20 men will take 180/20 = 9 days.

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 5:3 and their difference is 20. Find the numbers.
questions.explanation: Let numbers be 5x and 3x. Difference: 5x - 3x = 20, 2x = 20, x = 10. Numbers: 50 and 30.

questions.question: A train 100 meters long crosses a platform in 20 seconds. What is the speed of the train if the platform is 200 meters long?
questions.explanation: Distance = train length + platform length = 100 + 200 = 300 meters. Time = 20 seconds. Speed = 300/20 = 15 m/s.

questions.question: If the cost price of 10 articles is Rs. 100, what is the cost price of 15 articles?
questions.explanation: Cost price of 10 articles = Rs. 100. Cost price of 1 article = Rs. 10. Cost price of 15 articles = 15 × 10 = Rs. 150.

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 15 km/h and the speed of the current is 3 km/h. What is the upstream speed?

questions.explanation: a² + b² + 2ab = (a+b)² = (5+3)² = 8² = 64. Option A gives 64.

questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a woman said, 'The man in the photograph is the son of my father's only sister.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: My father's only sister = my aunt. Her son = my cousin. So the man is the woman's cousin.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, 25
questions.explanation: All are prime numbers except 25 which is 5² (composite). So 25 is the odd one out.

questions.question: If A is to the South of B, and B is to the East of C, in which direction is C from A?
questions.explanation: A is South of B, so B is North of A. B is East of C, so C is West of B. From A, C is North and West, i.e., North-West.

questions.question: Arrange the following in logical order: 1. Leaf 2. Tree 3. Seed 4. Fruit 5. Flower
questions.explanation: Seed -> Tree -> Flower -> Fruit -> Leaf.

questions.explanation: These are perfect squares: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5², so next is 6² = 36.

questions.question: If 'CAT' is coded as 'DBU', what will be the code for 'DOG'?
questions.explanation: CAT to DBU: C→D (+1), A→B (+1), T→U (+1). So each letter is shifted by +1. So DOG: D→E (+1), O→P (+1), G→H (+1). So EPH. Option A.

questions.question: How many squares are there in a 3×3 chessboard?
questions.explanation: Number of squares in n×n grid = n(n+1)(2n+1)/6. For 3×3: 3×4×7/6 = 84/6 = 14. (9 small + 4 medium + 1 large = 14).
